import sys

def solve() -> None:
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = next(it)
    a = [next(it) for _ in range(3)]
    b = [next(it) for _ in range(3)]
    
    max_wins = min(a[0], b[1]) + min(a[1], b[2]) + min(a[2], b[0])
    # min losses = max(0, a[i] + b[(i+2)%3] - n) summed
    min_wins = 0
    for i in range(3):
        val = a[i] + b[(i + 2) % 3] - n
        if val > 0:
            min_wins += val
    sys.stdout.write(f"{min_wins} {max_wins}\n")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
